target: ND (national demand, MW): transmission demand excluding station load, pumping and exports
temperature_note: Daily GB average temperature outturn (BMRS TEMP), repeated over the 48 half-hours of its local day. It is an actual, not a forecast: an oracle covariate.
neso_note: NESO notes data issues on its Demand Data Update for 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-13 (under review on 2026-10-20); those days are used as published.
